query:
UPDATE error_injection.config
            SET
                endpoint_pattern = $2,
                http_method = $3,
                error_rate = $4,
                error_code = $5,
                error_message = $6,
                latency_ms = $7,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                id,
                endpoint_pattern,
                http_method,
                error_rate,
                error_code,
                error_message,
                latency_ms
